findings.evidence: Lines 95–137 define both left/right variants for zero, addition, subtraction, and negation; `rg "apply_smul_(left|right)"` finds no corresponding declarations.
findings.fix: Add `apply_smul_left` and `apply_smul_right` lemmas for real scalars.
findings.issue: The public bilinear evaluation API covers zero/add/sub/neg but omits scalar multiplication in both arguments, so users cannot characterize `form x` as bilinear without reverting to `bilinFormAt`.

findings.evidence: Lines 94–137 show only `apply_zero_right` at lines 101–104 has `@[simp]`, while all other linearity equations lack it.
findings.fix: Mark `apply_zero_left`, both add, both sub, both neg, and the new smul lemmas `@[simp]`; leave the orientation-sensitive swap lemma untagged.
findings.issue: The canonical evaluation normal forms are not marked `@[simp]`, except `apply_zero_right`; consequently simplification handles the second zero argument but not the first, and does not normalize add/sub/neg in either argument.

summary: The new pointwise two-form interface omits scalar-linearity lemmas and leaves its normalization rules largely unavailable to simplification.
